summary_md:
# Avsnitt 601 - Under ytan

**Feed**: fill-or-kill  
**Published**: 2026-10-06  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

The hosts say US indices are being propped up by about ten AI and hyperscaler stocks, while the other ~490 S&P 500 names, small caps and rate-sensitive sectors such as real estate are weak beneath the surface amid a bond-yield scare. They expect US authorities to keep shoring up the market until the midterm elections and turn cautious after them. Other themes: a biotech/AI 'bubble' that one host thinks is far from over, the Brazilian election, pandemic-scare stocks after a plague case in Russia, and the 'superintelligence' rebranding, which they dismiss as a PR stunt.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟢 BALD-B — Balder | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 60%

Host holds calls in Balder as a falling-rates play after heavy real-estate sell-offs.

#### Reasoning

Host is positioned in Balder calls, expecting US Treasury buybacks (Bessent) and a political push to cap yields before the midterms to bring rates down. Real estate has been sold off hard, so Balder would be a clear winner if rates turn. The trade is a leveraged, short-dated rate bet.

#### Sell Triggers

- if US 10y yields keep trending above ~5.3%
- if no rate relief before midterms

> *"Jag har kvar lite calls i Balder. För den var väldigt dålig nu."*

---

### 🟢 INTRUM — Intrum | **BUY** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 50%

Host bought Intrum as the largest proxy for high-rate pain, betting on lower rates.

#### Reasoning

Host bought Intrum (and real estate) after NFP, expecting yields to fall. He calls it the biggest proxy for suffering under high rates and notes it falls every day. This is a speculative mean-reversion bet tied to the rate outlook.

#### Sell Triggers

- if rates keep rising
- if the daily decline continues without rate relief

> *"den är väl största proxyn på att må dåligt när räntan är högt"*

---

### ⛔ NVAX — Novavax | **AVOID** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 70%

Pandemic-scare pumps keep recurring but the company fails to deliver vaccines; hosts suggest giving up on it.

#### Reasoning

Novavax rallied 20-30% on the Russian plague scare, repeating earlier pumps (avian flu, Ebola, COVID). Hosts say it is poor at bringing vaccines to market and that the plague is treatable with antibiotics. They suggest Emergent BioSolutions instead.

> *"någon gång måste vi ge upp på Novax globalt"*

---

### 🟠 EBS — Emergent BioSolutions | **WATCH** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 55%

Pure biodefence company with vaccines and countermeasures; worth tracking if outbreak fears grow.

#### Reasoning

Guest/host describes EBS as a pure biodefence company with BARDA ties, making anthrax, smallpox and Ebola countermeasures. It is proposed as a better pandemic/bioweapon-scare vehicle than Novavax.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the plague scare fades without spread

> *"Den är ju värd att känna till eftersom att det är ett renodlat biodefencebolag"*

---

### 🟡 MRVI — Maravai | **HOLD** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Host owns it; part of the genomics/biotech bubble thesis; a bid is reportedly on it.

#### Reasoning

Host discloses owning Maravai. It fits his biotech bubble thesis: his self-built index is up nearly 200% since March and he does not see the bubble ending. A bid on the company was mentioned.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the biotech bubble rolls over
- if the bid falls through

> *"Jag äger Maravai och Abcellera"*

---

### 🟡 ABCL — AbCellera | **HOLD** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Host owns it; first with a COVID antibody, DARPA collaboration, positioned for pandemic and AI-biotech themes.

#### Reasoning

Host owns AbCellera and highlights it as a first responder in pandemics (first COVID antibody) with a DARPA partnership. It fits the AI-biotech theme he expects to keep running.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the biotech theme fades

> *"Abcellera var ju först med antikroppen mot covid"*

---

### 🟠 TWST — Twist Bioscience | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 45%

Leading genomics 'bottleneck' name with strong demand; part of a biotech bubble seen as still early.

#### Reasoning

Twist makes DNA on silicon chips and everyone is clamouring for its products. It has run hard, but the host argues the biotech bubble is far from over given low historical valuations, large cash piles and M&A premiums.

#### Sell Triggers

- if biotech valuations overheat
- if AI enthusiasm reverses

> *"Och alla skriker efter deras produkter."*

---
